Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded that "Name the Man" (1923) was the sole film being referred to in the task, without sufficiently verifying if other films with similar titles existed. While successive steps attempted to resolve the ambiguity, this initial error set the tone for the rest of the discussion, leading to a prolonged cycle of unproductive searches and redundant actions. WebSurfer failed to adequately reconcile the two possible films, and the Planner was forced to react to incomplete and ambiguous information. The WebSurfer agent violated error detection patterns seen in Example 1 and 4, specifically by failing to resolve conflicting information and relying on repeated searches with insufficient disambiguation strategies.
